newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Eritrea says Yemen detaining its diplomatic bags.
newsitem.headline: Eritrea says Yemen detaining its diplomatic bags.

text.p: Eritrea has complained to the United Nations that security authorities in Yeman have been detaining diplomatic pouches destined for the Eritrean embassy in Sanaa since April.
The two countries are in a dispute over the small island of Lesser Hanish, near tanker routes at the Red Sea's southern entrance.
"These bags are being held by them for days and presumably searched, while daily requests by our embassy for their delivery are scornfully ignored," Eritrean Foreign Minister Petros Solomon said.

In a letter to Secretary-General Boutros Boutros-Ghali circulated on Monday, he said Eritrea had shown restraint over "this and other provocative acts of hostility" by the government of Yemen. "However, patience has its own limits," he added.
